entries.name: Murai-P3 (mse_ge1, this repo)
flags: the weight-space error table [L38-L44] (mean rel^2, mean rel_l2, mean cos against the BF16 master) is not a KL, top-1 or perplexity metric and no metric key fits, so it is not mapped
behavioural gate pass counts [L48-L54] are fractions whose pass count and denominator sit in separate candidate ids, so they are not mapped
third-party KLD values for EXL3 and NVFP4 [L58] sit inside one prose cell and are not mapped; the card says it has no KLD measurement of its own [L146]
the serving corruption numbers [L62-L66] are a numeric proof on one layer and are not mapped
